title: Invoice spotcheck + sprint runbook — Samir's finance/legal scratchpad
content:
Quick morning scratchpad — do not over-polish

Context: small personal checklist for daily invoice triage, quick contract redlines I own this sprint, and renewal reminders (vendors + Dedicated trials). Mostly copy/paste of things I need to clear before EOD.

MORNING PIVOTS (10–20m)
- Inbox: vendor-invoices@ — prioritize >$25k (mark urgent)
- Run query: FIN-OpenInvoices (filter vendor: CloudCache, status: pending)
- Outstanding POs to match: PO-9843 (CloudCache), PO-10011 (EdgeLabs)
- Quick note: if vendor asks for Net30 extension, escalate to Priya (cc legal)

INVOICE SPOTCHECK (manual)
- [ ] CloudCache invoice 2026-02-15 — check rates, signs, PO match (PO-9843). Suspect duplicate: line 3 vs 2026-01 invoice. If duplicate -> open dispute doc, tag Daniel.
- [ ] VertexEdge invoice 03-01 — tax fields missing, ping vendor via invoices template (use canned email VENDOR_INVOICE_REQUEST v2).
- [ ] Small pays (<$2k) batch — approve if GL mapping present and QR code scanned.

CONTRACT REDLINES (quick list for sprint)
- Draft: SOW-Redwood-EdgeLabs-v3 (review comments from legal@)
  * Top 3 redlines I own: 1) Data residency clause — propose: add subclause limiting non-prod copy (suggest language). 2) SLA credits cap — reduce from 30% to 15%. 3) IP carve-out for customer-generated models — small tweak.
- Notes to self: leave TODO markers in doc for eng review (link to GH issues). Use inline comment template: '@eng: confirm model export allowed for debugging only'.

RENEWALS / TRIALS TRACKER (tiny)
- EdgeCache renewal (30-day notice required) — renewal due 2026-03-25. Start renewal convo by 2026-03-05.
- Security scan vendor (trial) ends 2026-03-10 — if no decision, auto-cancel; ask Jeremy for headcount allocation.

RISKS / BLOCKERS
- AP automation (new OCR pipeline) still failing on PDFs with multiple invoice tables — escalate to infra (SRE ticket: SRE-1182).
- Vendor legal requests redlined clauses we already negotiated; copy/paste of old terms showing up. Keep a short history snippet in Confluence to reference (Confluence: InvoiceNegotiationHistory).

COMMUNICATIONS (snippets to send)
- To vendor (CloudCache): 'Hi — we need clarified line items and PO number match. Please resend scanned invoice with PO attached. If not received in 3 business days we'll hold payment.'
- To Priya: short ask template when escalation needed (include escalations matrix).

END-OF-DAY DONE CHECK
- [ ] All >$25k invoices triaged or in dispute doc
- [ ] Contract redlines pushed to reviewers in GH/Confluence
- [ ] Renewal reminders scheduled in calendar (30/15/7 days)

RANDOM NOTES / TODOS (brain dump)
- Follow up on FIN-4821 — missing approval chain for March vendor block.
- Create a 1-pager: 'How to triage an invoice' for new hires — base off this doc.
- Keep short list of canned emails in Drive (create if not exist).
- Check whether Dedicated accounts get separate billing bucket (ask Billing infra).

Unresolved questions:
- Are we backdating PO acceptance if vendor claims earlier delivery? Where is policy doc? (link: Confluence: PO-acceptance-policy)
- What is current threshold for manual sign-off in AP vs automated?

Scratchpad end. Will tidy after weekly sync with Priya.

---
Revision log (brief): 2026-02-28 initial notes; 2026-03-05 added CloudCache duplicate check; 2026-03-12 updated renewal dates and escalations.
